request.text: Pip the rabbit wants to place a sticky note on a toy cabinet. The note sticks to Pip's finger instead. Pip peels with the other hand and it splits into two notes, one per hand. Each pull doubles the sticky notes from two to four to eight, covering Pip's arms and face. Pip sees the note-covered reflection in a mirror and gasps. Pip remains covered until a sneeze scatters the notes onto the cabinet. Pip is relieved, but the cabinet remains messy.
